run.decision: FAIL / NO_CANDIDATE_ADMITTED. The frozen 日K高速005 2-of-4 multifactor filter produced 2.075348% CAGR, 0.426032 Sharpe and 7.794649% MDD versus 0.363091% CNY cash. It completed 333 round trips with 74.774775% wins, 0.152373% average net return and profit factor 1.287513. The unfiltered base-pullback control was better on CAGR (2.516575%), Sharpe (0.490865), average trade (0.173828%) and profit factor (1.337021). Thus the preregistered trend-alignment, RSI3, volatility-expansion and bullish-rejection vote did not add incremental selection value; only 3/5 folds had positive Sharpe. At 0.05% adverse slippage per fill, candidate CAGR was 0.871808%, Sharpe 0.195190 and MDD 9.255634%. Exposure, cash, holding-period, cross-calendar marking and final-liquidation invariants passed. Per the stop rule, no alternative vote threshold, factor deletion, factor weighting or indicator tuning is permitted inside 005.

methodology.follow_up_policy: After any formal 005 metric is viewed, do not change the 2/4 vote requirement, factor definitions, SMA/ATR/RSI lookbacks, pullback or candle thresholds, take-profit, holding period, allocation, assets, fee, slippage or cross-calendar marking inside this trial. maximum gross <=100%, minimum end-of-day cash >=0, every trade holds 2-5 observed asset sessions and final open positions =0

version.mechanism_text: A daily-scale one-ATR pullback above SMA(200) is more likely to reverse when at least two independent confirmations agree across slow trend alignment, short-term RSI oversold state, volatility expansion and bullish intraday rejection. The fixed 2-of-4 filter should improve net trade quality and risk-adjusted performance over the unfiltered 004 base rule across gold, Nasdaq and S&P 500.

allowed_changes: retain the frozen 004 base setup: previous close above SMA(200) and two-session decline at least 1.00 times ATR(14)
add exactly four equal binary T-1 factor votes: SMA(50)>SMA(200), RSI(3)<=30, ATR(14)>ATR(60), and a bullish rejection bar with close>open and close location>=0.60
enter only when at least two of four factor votes pass; no alternative vote threshold or factor weighting
retain the 004 next-open entry, no entry-session exit, 0.75 ATR profit limit from held session two and held-session-five close expiry
standalone 100% sleeve runs plus one fixed one-third-per-asset combined run, matched unfiltered base controls, CNY cash and 0.05% per-fill adverse-slippage stress
forbidden_changes: reading execution-session high, low or close before the opening buy decision
allowing a same-session take-profit exit on the entry bar
testing or selecting among 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 or 4/4 vote requirements
optimizing factor weights, periods, RSI threshold, candle close location, ATR comparison or trend comparisons
any post-result change to the base pullback, take-profit or holding-period parameters
using synthetic OHLC or omitting carried value for a held asset on its non-session date
asset-specific parameters or dropping a weak gold, Nasdaq or S&P 500 component
adding MACD, volume, calendar, stop-loss, shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or negative weights
changing the user-specified fee or hiding the preregistered slippage stress
representing index OHLC execution as directly investable product evidence

shared_rules.entry: buy current real daily open after T-1 base setup and at least 2/4 votes
shared_rules.exit: no entry-day exit; from held session 2 sell at entry open + 0.75 * frozen T-1 ATR14 if daily high reaches it, otherwise held session 5 close
